South Ithilien

A strip of land between the Anduin to the west and Ephel Duath to the east. 

 Size: 600 x 500 
 Lairs: 6x Warg Lair, 2x Troll Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 2x Inn
Ost-in-Edhil

Ost-in-Edhil was established by the Noldor during the early parts of the Second Age, located where the Sirannon met the Glanduin.

 Size: 400 x 400
 Lairs: 2x Warg Lair, 2x Goblin Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 1x Signal Fire
The Crossroads

The Crossroads of Ithilien is a point where the road that leads to the Black Gate meets with the road that leads to Minas Tirith. Frodo and Sam passed by the Crossroads on their way to Cirith Ungol. 

 Size: 400 x 400 
 Lairs: 2x Warg Lair, 2x Goblin Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 1x Signal Fire
Udun

The lands behind the Black Gate known as Udun take the name of the underworld due to the volcanic ash and noxious fumes that cover them.

 Size: 400 x 400
 Lairs: 2x Warg Lair, 2x Goblin Lair 
 Neutral Structures: 1x Signal Fire
